title: Unavailable Cameras are not shown in the Camera picker
problem: The visual editor filters camera entities whose current Home Assistant state is unknown or unavailable, even though the same entities are accepted through YAML.
reproduce: Populate hass.states with camera.available, camera.unavailable and camera.unknown; the pinned editor list drops the latter two before rendering suggestions.
acceptance: The editor offers every camera.* entity present in hass.states regardless of runtime state, excludes non-camera entities, preserves friendly-name ordering, and the complete project check passes.
repair: Move editor camera discovery into a tested pure helper that filters only by the camera domain and deliberately keeps unknown and unavailable entities.

verification.limitations: BCL executes the real editor-list regression and all repository checks against deterministic Home Assistant state fixtures. It does not render the card inside a running Home Assistant instance.
verification.ownerCheck: Open the visual editor while a camera entity is unavailable or unknown, search under Cameras in picker, and confirm it can be selected and saved without switching to YAML.

upstream.suiteOutputIncludes: PASS: unavailable and unknown cameras remain selectable

publish.commitMessage: Keep unavailable cameras selectable in the editor
